title: Cousin marriage and inherited risk
summary: Marriage between relatives, such as cousins, is common in many families and cultures. It raises the chance of some recessive conditions mainly when both partners carry a changed copy of the same gene, because relatives are more likely to share the same changed genes.
body: Most children of cousin couples are born healthy. Screening shows whether both partners carry the same change, and counselling explains what that means for each pregnancy. These services exist to support couples and families with information, not to judge their choices.
